stemMd: A convex quadrilateral has all four vertices on one circle. Two opposite interior angles are (2x + 10)° and (3x − 5)°. What is x?
explanationMd: Opposite interior angles of a cyclic quadrilateral sum to 180°. Therefore (2x + 10) + (3x − 5) = 180, so 5x + 5 = 180 and x = 35. The resulting angles are 80° and 100°, both valid interior angles.

distractorRationale.a: The opposite angles would total only forty degrees.
distractorRationale.b: The opposite angles would total 130°, not 180°.
distractorRationale.d: The opposite angles would total 230°, not 180°.
distractorRationale.e: The opposite angles would total 280°, not 180°.
